## When to Use

Use when seeking funding approval, justifying a major investment decision, or establishing executive agreement on project value. This template is essential for high-complexity projects, significant budget allocations, or strategic initiatives where stakeholder alignment is critical.

## When NOT to Use

Do not use for small, tactical, or low-risk initiatives where the cost of a formal business case exceeds the decision benefit. Avoid using this template if decision-makers need rapid approval and cannot afford the time for detailed case development.
